verdict.rationale: A hands-on probe confirms Restate serves a live llms.txt at docs.restate.dev (HTTP 200). Doc pages are also available as .md endpoints, and the first-party AI-assistant docs describe a plugin that teaches coding agents (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor) Restate's APIs, pitfalls and agent patterns. Missing for 10: independent community corroboration of agents successfully consuming these docs, and no evidence of an llms-full.txt or similar full-corpus export.
